archetypes.name: dyn-plan-size-contract
archetypes.rationale: Changed size-trigger precedence and suppression semantics need contract-focused review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan-size check changes for byte-compatible output and trigger semantics. Confirm diff_added and diff_lines reasons are independently emitted in stable order, mechanical_churn only affects SOFT_ADVISORY, and trusted oversize_override remains the sole hard-trigger suppression path. Pay close attention to tests that pin the #6524 metadata shape and to the docs wording for the live issue-anchored plan contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
